cards.front: Which letter can go before V and X to subtract?
cards.back:
I
IV is 4 and IX is 9.
cards.say: Which letter can go before V and X to subtract? I. I V is four and I X is nine.

cards.front: How many times can I, X, C or M repeat in a row?
cards.back: At most 3 times. We write IV for 4, not IIII.
cards.say: How many times can I, X, C or M repeat in a row? At most three times. We write I V for four, not I I I I.

cards.front: Which Roman numerals are never repeated?
cards.say: Which Roman numerals are never repeated? V, L and D
